[mainflow_postconditions_reachability] Postcondition 4 introduces a ballistic-missile track and associated launch point boundary, but the Preconditions scope the reported item to a Subsurface contact and the Main Flow handles only a generic track. A ballistic missile track is not a subsurface contact, so this postcondition is not reachable from the stated Preconditions and Main Flow; the item-type scoping is inconsistent across the vertical flow. [trigger_preconditions_coverage] The trigger includes a correlation branch in which the C2 JU correlates PPLI reports with local sensor data for a track for which another C2 JU holds R2, and an inactivity branch in which the current reporting unit is declared inactive. These branches require a starting state where the primary-actor C2 JU is not the current reporting R2 holder (or is assuming R2 from another holder), but the preconditions assert that the C2 JU currently holds R2 and is reporting the track, with no other JU reporting the same contact. The main flow and postconditions also only complete the TQ-superiority relinquishment branch, so the trigger launches a different scenario that is not vertically supported.
